items.title: 4 FBR officials, traffic policeman martyred in DI Khan attacks: police
items.description:
DERA ISMAIL KHAN: Four Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) officials were martyred in firing by unidentified assailants near Qureshi Mor in Dera Ismail Khan, while a separate attack on a highway traffic police mobile near the Mufti Mahmood Chowk bypass left a constable martyred and another injured, police said on Tuesday.
Dera Ismail Khan District Police Officer Ziauddin Ahmad told Dawn that two of the four FBR officials were serving with the board on a contractual basis.
The assailants fled after the attacks, prompting police to cordon off the areas and launch search operations, the police added.

items.title: Police fire teargas as French students, teachers, parents take to streets
items.description:
Police fired tear gas at protesters outside French high schools on Tuesday as students, teachers and parents took to the streets on the biggest day of what Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu described as the most violent school protests in decades.
The protests, in which a teenager lost a hand on Monday, were the latest manifestation of public anger in a country where the far right and far left are surging ahead of a presidential election in the spring.

items.title: PM Shehbaz says law took its course in AJK after 'unfortunate events' in recent months
items.description:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Tuesday expressed dismay over the “unfortunate events” in Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) in recent months, adding that, however, the law took its course.
He was addressing a ceremony in Islamabad in which four AJK Council members – nominated by the AJK Legislative Assembly – were administered the oath by PM Shehbaz, who is the chairman of the council.
Referring to the “unfortunate events” in recent months in AJK, he said: “We all regretted it, wished that they did not do that. We all tried to make them understand with utter seriousness”.

items.description:
A former German spy chief was arrested on Tuesday on suspicion of passing sensitive information to foreign powers, an embarrassing case that comes as the country is seeking to bolster its intelligence agencies.
August Hanning, who ran Germany’s BND foreign intelligence agency from 1998 to 2005, is accused of espionage, treason and working for foreign intelligence services, federal prosecutors said.
They did not say which foreign powers were involved. However, AFP understands that it was not Russia.

items.title: Kenya confirms first Ebola case imported from Congo, patient has died
items.description:
Kenya has recorded its first confirmed Ebola case, a Kenyan citizen who has been living in Democratic Republic of Congo and arrived in Nairobi on Saturday, Health Minister Aden Duale said.
The patient has since died, and 28 contacts have been identified so far including family members and health workers, Duale told a press conference.
So far “only one test has turned positive and is the one that we have just discussed”, he said.

items.title: Security forces kill 5 terrorists in North Waziristan IBO: state media
items.description:
Security forces on Tuesday killed five terrorists in an intelligence-based operation (IBO) in North Waziristan, state broadcaster Radio Pakistan reported.
Two terrorists were injured in the operation, it said.
Forces targeted hideouts of the terrorists, who belonged to Fitna al-Khawarij, according to security sources.
Fitna al Khawarij is a term the state uses for terrorists belonging to the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan.

items.title: Last ruler of Khairpur State passes away
items.description:
SUKKUR: Mir Ali Murad Khan Talpur, the last ruler of the former princely state of Khairpur, passed away here on Monday. He was 93.
He has left behind two sons and a daughter.
The funeral prayers will be offered at Kot Diji on Tuesday (today) at 11am.
The late Talpur played a significant role in the history of Khairpur State during the transition following the creation of Pakistan.
After Pakistan came into being, he placed his trust in Quaid-i-Azam Mohammad Ali Jinnah and signed an instrument of accession of Khairpur State to Pakistan.
